messages:
Ivy L: Heads up  we got final traffic + security checklist from OrionHealth. Peak: ~6k req/min chat (baseline 2k/min). Embedding batches spike to ~12k/min for short 5-10m windows. They want p99 chat <200ms and a predictable 12mo bill. Need presales sizing, reserved GPU rec, autoscale suggestion, and answers for KMS/VPC/audit.
Marco D: Quick unit check: 6k/min is 100 RPS baseline; bursts to ~200 RPS. Which models?
Ivy L: Chat -> redwood-2-7b (q4_0). Embeds -> embed-lite.
Jen S: Bench numbers: redwood-2-7b at ~320 tokens (256 in + 64 out) gives ~120150 RPS/GPU on A100-class when q4_0 with batching + KV cache. Embeds ~1.1k-1.3k/min per GPU.
Ravi K: Recommendation: separate pools. For deterministic cost propose reserving 2 chat GPUs (baseline + small headroom) and 1 embed GPU. Add burst pool (autoscale) to allow up to +3 GPUs across pools for short windows.
Ivy L: How do we ensure p99 stays <200ms during embed batches?
Jen S: Keep embed pool isolated from chat. Require a 5-10m scheduled preheat for known batch jobs to warm KV cache (saves ~20-30% compute). Also enable prefix caching for chat and target p95-driven scale triggers.
Marco D: Autoscale example we can include in SOW:
```
metric: chat_rps
scale_up: { threshold: 140, add: 1, cooldown: 60 }
scale_down: { threshold: 80, remove: 1, cooldown: 120 }
max_replicas: 6
```
Marco D: Set scale_up around the RPS where p95 starts to climb (140-160).
Jen S: Pricing suggestion: 12mo commit covering 2 chat GPUs + 1 embed GPU at ~30% committed discount. Include a monthly burst-credit pool (e.g., 150 GPU-hours) and on-demand overage pricing. Add clause to exclude scheduled batch windows from overage or use prebooked burst credits.
Ivy L: Security checklist: VPC peering, customer KMS, and audit log retention. Can hosted meet this?
AutoBot: SOC2: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2.pdf
AutoBot: VPC peering guide: https://redwood.example.com/private/vpc-peering
AutoBot: KMS options: hosted-managed or Private deployment with customer-managed KMS.
Ravi K: I'll take the security questionnaire (KMS/VPC/audit). Jen please draft the capacity runbook and autoscale thresholds + preheat steps. Marco can you draft pricing + burst-credit language?
Marco D: On it.
Jen S: For the POC they asked for a 3-day smoke test next Tue. Recommend two lanes: (1) Chat lane: steady baseline + synthetic spikes to validate autoscale and p99; (2) Embed lane: scheduled batch runs with preheat to validate throughput and KV warm. SRE slot needed for monitoring and rollback hooks.
Ivy L: Okay. Please drop runbook, pricing sheet, and questionnaire answers in this thread by Friday EOD. If we can get SRE on calendar I'll confirm the POC. :thumbsup:
Marco D: Will post pricing draft.
Ravi K: I'll post answered questionnaire in-thread.
Jen S: I'll upload runbook + sample load curves before Friday.
